certifiedResults.metadataNotes: Official West Virginia Secretary of State Clarity ENR static JSON for the 2024 General Election. The parser reads the statewide presidential contest summary and county detail feed for ENR version 356048, then validates county candidate sums against statewide totals.

reviewCharts.warning: West Virginia review rows currently include official Monongalia County precinct rows only. Remaining counties stay county-level until their official county precinct summaries are collected and mapped. The Monongalia precinct summary includes presidential write-in totals in other/total; the statewide ENR county row does not expose those write-ins in its other-candidate total.
